access_note: The limited LCIA-method edition is free. Download requires an email address and agreement to the software licence. Neither step was taken.
description: LCA4Waste is published by ETH Zurich. LCA4Waste supports resource-use and waste-treatment decisions through life-cycle calculations. Its stated coverage is Energy-intensive industries and dedicated waste-treatment processes. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed XLSM resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. The free edition offers reduced impact-assessment methods and requires registration plus licence acceptance; neither was completed. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
